title: Marlowe Rewards Notes: Conversion Block, Note Value and Validity
content:
Available Marlowe Rewards points convert into Marlowe Rewards Notes in fixed blocks. The block size and note value are the same at every tier. How long a note stays valid depends on the tier at which it is issued.

## Note validity by tier

| Tier | Validity of a Marlowe Rewards Note issued at this tier (calendar days from the issue date) |
|---|---|
| Marlowe Rewards Member | 60 |
| Marlowe Rewards Silver | 60 |
| Marlowe Rewards Gold | 75 |
| Marlowe Rewards Platinum | 90 |
| Marlowe Rewards Icon | 90 |
| Marlowe Rewards Atelier | 120 |

## Conversion terms common to every tier

| Term | Every tier |
|---|---|
| Available points converted into one reward unit | 2000 points |
| Value of one reward unit on the issued Marlowe Rewards Note | 20.00 USD |
| Conversion runs automatically on the nightly run, without a request from the member | Yes |
| Conversion is blocked while the total points balance is below zero | Yes |
| Note value spent on merchandise that is later refunded is reissued as a new note | Yes |
| Minimum validity of a reissued note, from its reissue date | 14 calendar days |

## Illustrations (hypothetical figures)

- One reward unit is 2000 points and is worth 20.00 USD on the note. Three units are 6000 points and 60.00 USD.
- A note issued at Marlowe Rewards Gold carries 75 days of validity, and one issued at Marlowe Rewards Atelier carries 120 days.
- A reissued note carries at least 14 calendar days of validity from the day it is reissued.
